name: rogowskikernelpilot
description: Analyze existing CUDA kernels and validate model-assisted optimization proposals with correctness tests and GPU measurements.

kernelpilot.modelProvider.description: Chat API protocol. OpenAI-compatible endpoints are supported when they implement /v1/chat/completions.

kernelpilot.modelEndpoint.description: Fallback base URL. KERNELPILOT_AI_BASE_URL in environment/.env takes precedence; remote compatible endpoints require HTTPS.

kernelpilot.cudaOptimizationProfile.description: Optimization objective supplied to the model; it does not change validation requirements.

kernelpilot.cudaValidationHarness.description: Optional workspace-relative independent .cu harness. It must include the source using #include KERNELPILOT_KERNEL_SOURCE and emit KP_RESULT,<case>,PASS|FAIL,<median_ms>,<p95_ms> records after deterministic correctness checks and synchronized repeated GPU timing.

kernelpilot.cudaArchitecture.description: Optional CUDA target such as sm_80. When empty, KernelPilot uses the detected GPU compute capability; if no GPU is detected, nvcc chooses its default.

kernelpilot.cudaProfileTranslationUnit.description: Optional workspace-relative .cu translation unit that invokes the selected .cu/.cuh function or kernel. Required when KernelPilot cannot identify a unique calling program.

kernelpilot.cudaProfileWarmupRuns.description: Number of full-program warmup executions before CUDA source profiling. User program side effects are repeated.

kernelpilot.cudaProfileRepetitions.description: Number of full-program measured executions for CUDA source profiling. User program side effects are repeated.

kernelpilot.analyzerPath.description: Path to the KernelPilot native analyzer executable. Leave empty to use native-analyzer/build/kernelpilot-analyzer in the extension folder.

kernelpilot.benchmarkCompiler.description: Compiler executable for native benchmarks. Leave empty to use gcc for C and g++ for C++.

kernelpilot.cudaCompiler.description: CUDA compiler executable used for the existing .cu experiment workflow and generated comparisons.

kernelpilot.cpuCompiler.description: C++ compiler used to syntax-check AI-generated CPU conversions.

kernelpilot.chatModel.description: Model identifier for chat. Set this to the exact model ID available through the configured provider.

kernelpilot.codingModel.description: Model identifier for code and benchmark tasks. Set this to the exact model ID available through the configured provider.

commands.title: KernelPilot: Analyze and propose optimization for existing .cu
KernelPilot: Compile, validate, and benchmark CUDA experiment
KernelPilot: Review code with local AI
KernelPilot: Convert file or selection to CUDA
KernelPilot: Convert CUDA file or selection to CPU

editor/context.when: editorLangId == c || editorLangId == cpp || editorLangId == cuda-cpp || resourceExtname == .cu || resourceExtname == .cuh

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
